messages:
mia: Heads-up — Deploybot kicked off v2.1.0 staged rollout at 11:02 PT, initial canary 10% global. Changewindow 11:00-14:00 PT. Release notes: https://redwood/release/2190

deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout id r-2190 started. Targets: all regions. Canary group: 10% traffic. Monitoring hooks enabled. To pin or adjust: `deploybot help` or `deploybot pin <rollout-id> --region=<region>`

sam: Quick q — do we want to pin eu-west to 2.0.9 until infra patch lands? We saw a noisy KV cache OOM in eu-west yesterday.

luca: Infra follow-up: single host showed KV cache churn, mitigated. Patch queued for ~12:30 PT. If we pin now we block useful canary data. Suggest a soft-split in eu: 5% to v2.1.0, 95% to v2.0.9 so we still get signal.

taryn: Can the console express per-region splits? I'm +1 for soft-split. Also we should set clear rollback triggers. Stop/go? I'm leaning go (with eu soft-split).

ops-jen: Ops: ok for soft-split. I've added automatic alerts and an auto-rollback rule for eu: latency_tail_ms > 200ms OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m => rollback. Alerts: eu-canary-latency-tail, eu-canary-5xx :rotating_light:

sam: :thumbsup: i'll patch the release notes with the kvcache caveat and add debug headers we can use: `x-rw-canary: v2.1.0` for traced requests.

mia: I'm going to request the soft-split now: `deploybot update r-2190 --region=eu-west-1 --split=5,95` — will report back once accepted.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: update accepted. eu-west split set to 5% v2.1.0 / 95% v2.0.9. Canary monitors running. Next automated check in 10m.

luca: Watching infra logs/metrics. If KV cache OOM spikes > 3 hosts in 10m, i'll call for immediate rollback. I have the CLI handy to pin back: `deploybot pin r-2190 --region eu-west-1 --keep 2.0.9`

taryn: Planning to ramp global to 20% at 11:30 PT. Quick votes: mia (go), sam (go), luca (hold-if-oom), ops-jen (go), taryn (go). Any objections?

sam: No objections here. go for global ramp but keep eu soft-split until post-patch verification.

mia: Consensus = GO for global 20% at 11:30 PT. eu-west remains soft-split (5/95) until infra confirms patch. I'll update the release notes and the rollout doc. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Scheduled action: ramp r-2190 -> 20% at 11:30 PT. Auto-rollback hooks active. I'll post if any alert fires. Thread will remain open for alerts; otherwise we'll close after the bake window.
